expectations.text: Scans codebase for hardcoded values that should use existing tokens
expectations.evidence: Suggests using grep/search to find hardcoded hex values and px values, provides example commands

expectations.text: Identifies redundant or duplicate tokens in the token set
expectations.evidence: Mentions token bloat as a concept but does not provide a method to identify duplicates or near-duplicates

expectations.text: Checks component consistency against design system standards
expectations.evidence: Recommends manual review of components but no systematic consistency checking methodology

expectations.text: Flags specific files where developers created new tokens instead of reusing
expectations.evidence: Suggests looking for local variable definitions but no automated or systematic flagging approach

expectations.text: Produces an audit report with specific violations and remediation priorities
expectations.evidence: Provides suggestions for what to audit but no structured report, no severity levels, no remediation plan
